scenes.title: 機台前，她看著裡面
scenes.beat_zh: 你們走到娃娃機前，她貼近玻璃看，轉頭問你想先夾哪一隻。
scenes.action: The woman stands in front of the claw machine on the right of the frame, one hand resting on its glass, looking at the plush toys inside and then at the viewer with wide, delighted eyes.

video.description: The woman in the first frame, in her lavender crew-neck sweatshirt and blue jeans, looks at the plush toys inside the claw machine on the right, then turns her bright eyes to the viewer. The woman (S1), in a clear, warm voice with a natural Taiwanese Mandarin accent, says: <d>[Chinese] 哇，裡面好多娃娃。你想先夾哪一隻？</d> Then she smiles at the viewer, one hand resting on the glass. Her movements make only quiet, light sounds. The camera holds a steady shot.

overlay.question: 差一點，怎麼辦？
overlay.caption: 啊，差一點點就掉進去了。

video.description: The woman in the first frame, in her lavender crew-neck sweatshirt and blue jeans, has her hands at her cheeks and watches the claw hanging just above the white-and-lilac plush inside the machine on the right. The claw closes on the plush and lifts it a little, then loosens, and the same plush settles back into its place, keeping its shape and colour. The woman (S1), in a clear, warm voice with a natural Taiwanese Mandarin accent, says: <d>[Chinese] 啊，差一點點就掉進去了。</d> Then she shakes her head with a laugh and keeps smiling at the viewer. The camera holds a steady shot.
video.soundscape: Quiet arcade in the evening: a soft electronic jingle far away and a gentle hum from the machines, with her clear voice in front. Near the end, a bright little chime sounds from the machine.
